# Battery Energy Storage (BatteryBESS)

> **Class**: `BatteryBESS` | **Module**: `energysim.models.storage` | [Validation benchmarks](../validation.md) | [Units](../units.md)

## Overview

Lithium-ion Battery Energy Storage System (BESS), Rint equivalent circuit.

The pack is a Rint model: an open-circuit voltage source Voc(SoC) in series
with an internal resistance Rin(SoC) (no RC / Thevenin polarisation
branches). Models:

- OCV curve Voc(SoC) and internal resistance Rin(SoC)
- inverter efficiency eta(P/P_rated)
- SoC integrates the *stored chemical power* Voc*I, so joule heat I^2*Rin is
  accounted for: P_dc = Voc*I + I^2*Rin (energy in = stored + heat)
- 1-state thermal balance: C_th * dT/dt = I^2 * Rin - (T - T_amb) / R_th
- calendar fade (Arrhenius-scaled) and cyclic fade (full equivalent cycles)

## Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Default | Unit | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | `str` | `'BESS'` | - | - |
| `capacity_mwh` | `float` | `1.0` | MWh | Nominal energy capacity in MWh. |
| `p_max_mw` | `float` | `0.5` | MW | Maximum charge/discharge power in MW (AC side). |
| `soc_init` | `float` | `0.5` | 1 | Initial state of charge [0.0, 1.0]. |
| `soc_min` | `float` | `0.05` | 1 | Operating SoC window; requests are scaled so SoC never leaves it. |
| `soc_max` | `float` | `0.95` | 1 | Operating SoC window; requests are scaled so SoC never leaves it. |
| `nominal_voltage_v` | `float` | `800.0` | V | Pack nominal DC voltage in Volts. |
| `c_th_kj_k` | `float` | `50000.0` | kJ/K | Lumped thermal capacitance of pack in kJ/K. |
| `r_th_k_w` | `float` | `0.002` | K/W | Thermal resistance to ambient in K/W. |
| `t_init_c` | `float` | `25.0` | degC | Initial battery temperature in degrees C. |
| `ocv_curve` | `Optional[Curve1D]` | `None` | - | - |
| `rin_curve` | `Optional[Curve1D]` | `None` | - | - |
| `inverter_curve` | `Optional[Curve1D]` | `None` | - | - |
| `step_size` | `float` | `1.0` | s | - |
| `calendar_fade_pct_per_year_25c` | `float` | `2.0` | %/year | Calendar capacity fade per year at 25 C (Arrhenius scaled, Ea = 25 kJ/mol). |
| `cycle_life_to_eol` | `float` | `4000.0` | - | Full equivalent cycles (2 x nominal capacity of DC throughput) to reach `eol_fade`. |
| `eol_fade` | `float` | `0.2` | - | Cyclic capacity fade at `cycle_life_to_eol` (0.20 -> 80 % SOH). |

## Validity and notes

Validity: meaningful for roughly 0-45 C pack temperature, SoC between ~5 and
95 %, and |P| <= p_max_mw. SOH is floored at 0.5. ``Q_heat_kW`` is DC joule
heat only (inverter losses are not included).

## Usage example

```python
from energysim import world
from energysim.models import BatteryBESS

sim = world(start_time=0, stop_time=3600, t_macro=900)
sim.add_model('batterybess', model=BatteryBESS(), outputs=['P_actual', 'SoC', 'T_batt'], step_size=60)
res = sim.simulate()
print(res['batterybess'].tail(2))
```
